_readme: Golf Challenge switch. Set 'enabled' true/false and pick the 'event' preset key. The site reads this at page load: when enabled, the Golf nav links appear and all modal text comes from the chosen preset. The golf-sync.yml Action also checks 'enabled' and no-ops when false. Per-year tweaks: update subLine/announceLine dates and bump golfKey so returning visitors see the intro again.
